pages.contents: A photographed page headed CONSENT with a handwritten full name on the first line, three ticked confirmation boxes (seen the material, read the article submitted to Frontiers in Medicine, legally entitled to give consent) and eight numbered statements of understanding about anonymity, content, worldwide publication, press use, editing, no financial benefit, revocation and data retention; the page number 1 is at the bottom and the text continues onto page 2. A thin yellow-brown strip shows along the top edge.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Administrative informed-consent form with handwritten identity, signature, contact and date entries. It contains no patient history, test results, treatment or outcome, and no patient clinical facts are generated. Handwritten identifiers are not copied.
limitations: The form does not name which case it concerns, so no patient is assigned.
